recipes.name: Smooth and Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (9 inch) prepared chocolate cookie crumb crust

steps.text: Combine confectioners’ sugar, peanut butter, and cream cheese in a large bowl; whisk in whipped topping until smooth and no lumps remain.
Pour filling into pie crust; refrigerate until firm, about 3 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Smooth and Creamy Peanut Butter Pie
raw_recipe.description: This smooth and creamy peanut butter pie uses cream cheese, creamy peanut butter, confectioners’ sugar, whipped topping, and chocolate cookie crumb crust.

review.reviewBody: This recipe is awesome! It's got the least ingredients of all the other pies I looked at, and it is SO easy to make. I made it exact the first time, my family said it was "too sweet". (As if there were such a thing...but they are not that into sweets & when they do have them, they tend to think they have more sweetness than other people.) When I made it a second time, I cut the amount of sugar in half. Still "too sweet" for some family. I cut the sugar all the way down to 1/3 cup. Just right for them. AND, it still tastes sweet to those who DO eat sweets a lot & like the sweetness. I also changed from regular peanut butter to "natural" peanut butter on the most recent pie...and I think that toned some of the sweet down also. The *only* reason I changed the sugar amount originally was b/c of my family. I love the original...and I like the less sugar versions I made also.

This pie is awesome. I made a few minor changes for my (our) taste - used chunky PB. Made my own crust out of Oreo cookies (Oreo cookies with filling, finely crushed in food processor, mix in very soft butter until it holds together and baked off and cooled) make my own real whip cream. Topped with mini dark chocolate PB cups. Family said it is the best PB pie they ever had.

I made my own graham cracker crust, I put a chocolat pudding layer then added the p.b. mix (which I used 1 cup p.b., less 1 cup sugar, and a full 8oz cream cheese) froze it for about 3 hrs then put in fridge for hour before dinner. It was really good - very decedant and rich. next time would lighten up on p.b. to original 3/4 cup. still very good.

So so good!! I made an Oreo crust. And I put 1 cup sugar, 1 cup peanut butter, and 8 oz of whipped cream in the pie. I would recommend reducing sugar to just one cup, but I would do everything else per recipe next time to make it less rich and "lighter" for everyone else. 
I dropped whipped cream on top using a spoon,cut up I think 3 or 4 Reese's cups and placed those in the gaps between the whipped cream,and drizzled melted dark chocolate and peanut butter on top. It looked fantastic!

I used more cream cheese than the recommended 3 ozs it called for. Five ounces was definitely the sweet spot. Cream cheese is one of my favorite things to use.The organic peanut butter i used- Trader Joes was creamy but it was too liquidy so I used a little whipping cream to help it out a little. I then I added the Cool Whip and everything came out just the right texture. I then drenched the top with caramel sauce and decorated it with whipped cream and chocolate chips. The premade Oreo crust, I used was disappointing. It was the only chocolate cookie crust in the store. I think a chocolate chip cookie crust would have gone a whole lot better. Will have to try that next time. Overall, a huge success!

Delicious! I reduced powdered sugar to about 3/4 c., used natural peanut butter, and topped with a layer of fresh whipped cream and a drizzle of hot fudge topping before refrigerating. I didn't have a prepared pie crust so I made it in a quick & easy homemade Oreo crust - 24 crushed Oreos + 1/4 c. melted butter. My whole family & our friends loved it!

Delicious! I made my own oreo crust using 25 oreos and 1/4 cup of melted butter. Just put the oreos in the food processor and add the butter and then press into the pie tin. I used 8 oz of cool whip and then froze this pie instead of refrigerated. Yum!

I used another reviewer's adaptation of 8 oz. cream cheese, 1 c. powdered sugar, and 1 c. PB (only because I hated to have 5 oz. of cream cheese left over. Using the whole block was easier).
It was DELICIOUS, but only if you like PB as a dessert. Some of my family didn't care much for it for that reason, but two of us loved it.
I used whipped cream on top, since the filling didn't quite fill my graham cracker crust. The light whipped cream was the perfect compliment to the heavy filling.
Next time I will use my mixer to mix the filling. I was not able to blend it smoothly with just a whisk.

It’s great! Doubled the peanut butter and used butterfinger pieces on the top instead. Made my own crust. Amazing! By doubling the peanut butter but not adding extra sugar, it wasn’t too sweet. Any topping would work too! This is a keeper for me!!!

This pie was absolutely wonderful! This was the first dish I had ever brought over to my mother-in-law's house, and I was incredibly nervous since she has been a professional cook for 30 years. Imagine my relief when she ended up loving the pie! This was so easy to make, and everyone found it to be so yummy. I made the crust homemade with melted butter and crushes Chocolate Animal Crackers. For the top, I drizzled caramel and chocolate syrup and spread crushed Reese's Peanutbutter cups.

I used 8 oz cream cheese as recommended by other users. The cream cheese flavor is prominent, so keep that in mind if you choose to use 8 oz. I added sugar to taste; I used about 3/4 cup. I whipped my own cream (I don't care for Cool Whip). I whipped extra and used that to top the pie. I crushed peanut butter cups for the bottom of the pie and chopped more for the top. I threw it in the freezer for a quick set. It was pretty darn good. Using fresh home made whipped cream really put it over the top. I'll make this again, but plan on tweaking it to make it even better.
It’s super easy to make and very delicious!
Used 8oz Cool Whip and added powdered sugar to taste
Perfect peanut butter pie. I topped mine with crushed Reese's Pieces to add a little crunch. Yum!
Everyone who tried it LOVED it. It was FANTASTIC!! It was great. I'm totally going to make it again.
It is AMAZING!!
Easy and everyone loved it.
This is so tasty, I forgot to buy cream cheese so I made it with out. Tasted fine, just needed to keep in the fridge longer so it can “gel”.

been making this for years! The family loves it especially my peanut butter/chocolate loving husband.
I just went ahead and added the whole 6 oz block of cream cheese. 
trick is to actually give it time to setup in the fridge...good luck with that (but it really does make a difference- so try to resist for just a couple hours)

I used this recipe as a guideline. I made homemade Oreo crust, cut the sugar back and used real whipped cream. With these changes the pie was great, but very rich! A little piece is enough to satisfy, I will make again.
